top_story_headline: LCX launches Liberty DEX, opening its self-built routing engine to builders via API, SDK and MCP
top_story_comment: Cast yer eye back to October 2020: MetaMask launched in-wallet swaps at a 0.875% fee, then hauled in $310M cumulatively by December 2024, per Binance Research. That wake tells ye LCX can own every clever route yet leave the fattest treasure with whichever wallet or agent owns user intent; paid API calls be thin plunder unless Liberty becomes the default quote behind the confirm button. 🦑
